summary: Iteration 67: Backend API Tests for Admin Verifications and Bug Fixes. All 17 tests passed (100%). Verified login endpoints for admin and trainer, admin verification endpoints (unverified, approved, pending), background check status controls, and admin dashboard.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend is React Native/Expo - cannot be tested via browser. Backend-only testing as requested.

POST /api/auth/login (admin).description: Returns access_token with isAdmin=true for admin@rapidreps.com

POST /api/auth/login (trainer).description: Returns access_token with trainer role for test_trainer_iter25@test.com

GET /api/admin/verifications/unverified.description: Returns array of unverified trainers (trainers with role but no verification status)

GET /api/admin/verifications/pending.description: Returns pendingVerifications array with profile and user objects

POST /api/admin/verifications/{trainer_i.description: Sets background check status to 'passed' successfully
Sets background check status to 'pending' successfully
Sets background check status to 'failed' successfully

GET /api/admin/dashboard.description: Returns totalUsers, totalTrainers, totalTrainees, totalSessions, completedSessions stats

critical_code_review_comments: All requested backend endpoints are working correctly
Admin authentication and authorization working properly (403 for non-admins)
Background check status endpoint supports all three statuses: passed, pending, failed
Unverified trainers endpoint correctly identifies trainers with role but no verification status
Login endpoints return proper access_token and user data
